truth_record.title: Plugin registration overwrites an occupied slot without releasing the previous plugin state
truth_record.notes: Public td_register_plugin documents replacement of an existing name, but the implementation writes the target slot directly and increments count without invoking the old cleanup path or releasing stored context.
